# Start Damage Modification

Source: [wiki article 4445](../archive/4445.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Start Damage Modification](../../api/actions/start-damage-modification.md).

<a id="wiki-4445-n1"></a>

- Damage modifications affect receiver/damager pairs and expose Last Damage Modification ID; maximum 64 can be active.

<a id="wiki-4445-n2"></a>

- Unlike Set Damage Dealt, damage modifications affect players only, not owned objects such as barriers/turrets.

<a id="wiki-4445-n3"></a>

- Selected receivers, damagers and percentage can reevaluate continuously.
